## Purpose

What user problem does this address? Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Changes and boundaries

Summarize behavior, documentation or file-format changes. Explain anything that touches visibility, timing, imports, privacy or compatibility. Do not include private observations or exports.

## Verification

List the actual commands, environments and PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN outcomes. Include the exact source/runtime identity where relevant. Link reviewed synthetic visual evidence for layout changes. Do not imply emulation is a physical-device test or that software checks prove clinical/sensory safety.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md, and kept the change within its agreed scope.
- [ ] Source changes, if any, are reflected in the assembled imagery-app/index.html; generated HTML was not edited alone.
- [ ] Relevant regressions and the full applicable checks were run, or remaining blockers are stated above.
- [ ] User-facing documentation, changelog, data contracts and verified evidence/manifest are updated where applicable without preclaiming CI success.
- [ ] Layout changes include actual rendered/focus checks, not only CSS arithmetic.
- [ ] Public examples, screenshots, logs and the diff contain only reviewed synthetic content, with no credentials, private paths or personal exports.
- [ ] No unapproved license, publication, deployment, persistence, networking, stimulation capability or repository-security setting change is bundled here.

## Remaining limits

What still needs review or testing? State physical-device, accessibility or other acceptance that was not performed rather than checking it off.
